rule: Each month from one monthly expiry to the next, held to expiry: short 1 x n put contracts at spot*0.9625; long 1 x n put contracts at spot*0.9875; long 1 x n call contracts at spot*1.0125; short 1 x n call contracts at spot*1.0375.
strike_rule: nearest listed strike to spot*(1+offset), spot = underlying close on the roll date; offsets are fixed (step 2.5% of spot, half step 1.25%), not tuned

half_spread_per_share.status: ASSUMPTION: bars are trade prices, no historical quotes exist; entry pays/receives this per share

settlement: intrinsic value vs underlying close at expiry; far legs closed at the last bar at the near expiry
benchmark: buy_and_hold SPY, same lots, same dates
